subject: [Escalation] Hosted API p99 surge — KV/prefix warm-up impact
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@clearsight.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-11T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: sudden p99 spikes on hosted-api (started 08:10 PT)

Hi Dylan,

We're seeing a sudden spike in p95/p99 latency and an uptick in 502/504 errors hitting your hosted API starting ~08:10 PT. Key observations: 
- p95 jumped from ~180ms to ~720ms, p99 from ~290ms to ~1.4s.
- Error rate for /v1/generate (customer route) rose from 0.2% -> 2.8%.
- The spike is concentrated for requests with long prefixes (context length > 1k tokens).

I've attached a brief trace and node KV stats. Our users are impacted (in-product timeouts). Can you advise root cause and ETA for mitigation? We have a renewal conversation next week, so this is urgent.

Thanks,
Aisha
Operations Lead, Clearsight Analytics

Attachments: clearsight_p99_trace_0611.txt, node_kv_stats_0611.csv

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@clearsight.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Urgent: sudden p99 spikes on hosted-api (started 08:10 PT)

Looping infra and on-call eng — Aisha sent traces; Clearsight is seeing large p99 regressions concentrated on long-prefix requests. Please triage ASAP; customer-facing.

Initial asks:
- Confirm whether there was any config change or deployment around 08:00–08:10 PT.
- Check KV/prefix cache hit rates and whether a mass eviction or TTL change occurred.
- If this is a cold-warm problem, what mitigation can we apply in 30m? (rewarm, route fallback, temporary rate cap)

I will update Aisha every 30 minutes.

— Dylan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0122

Attachments: heap_snapshot_0611.json (sent by customer)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-11T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: sudden p99 spikes on hosted-api (started 08:10 PT)

Dylan, team — early triage notes from infra: 
- Around 08:04 PT an automated memory compaction job ran on a subset of serving nodes which triggered aggressive prefix cache eviction to reclaim RAM.
- At 08:06 PT our autoscaler observed increased tail latencies and restarted ~12 workers across the cluster; those restarted instances lost local prefix cache entries (cold KV miss).
- Combined effect: a cascading amplification where cold misses caused higher CPU and longer gpu kernel warmups, creating tail latency spikes for prefixes >1k tokens.

Confirmed via node_kv_stats_0611.csv: prefix_cache_hit_rate dropped from 98% -> 56% for affected nodes.

Short-term mitigations we recommend (ordered):
1) Run targeted rewarm script against Clearsight's heavy routes (we have a script that pre-populates KV for hot prefixes). Estimated time: 12–18 minutes.
2) Temporarily disable the aggressive compaction job for serving-pool-prod for 6 hours.
3) Stagger autoscaler restart window to avoid simultaneous cold restarts.
4) Add a small blackhole-rule to route heavy long-prefix traffic to warmed hosts only (10–30 min to implement).

We will provide a one-click revert for the compaction job and push a config to raise prefix_cache_ttl from 30m -> 6h for affected pool.

I'll kick off rewarm once we have customer permission.

— Marissa
Infra Lead, Serving Runtime

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-11T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: sudden p99 spikes on hosted-api (started 08:10 PT)

Quick add:
- We can also configure an immediate fallback routing policy for Clearsight to a warmed variant image (same model but pinned to nodes with intact KV). That would avoid user impact while we rewarm the full fleet. Rolling the fallback takes ~8 minutes to push with low risk.
- If customer prefers, we can route them to a dedicated warm pool (short-term reserve) for the next 24–48 hours; this is more manual and needs Ops signoff.

Recommend: Option A (fallback routing) + targeted rewarm.

Also flagging this for leadership — might need a small one-off credit and an incident note.

— Rishi
SRE

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@clearsight.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-11T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: sudden p99 spikes on hosted-api (started 08:10 PT)

Aisha — thanks for the quick signal and the traces. Short update and next steps: 
- Root cause: an infra memory compaction job plus simultaneous autoscaler restarts caused mass prefix cache invalidations and cold KV misses that amplified tail latency.
- Immediate actions (we're prepared to run on your approval):
  1) Push fallback routing for Clearsight to warmed hosts (8–10 min to apply).
  2) Run targeted rewarm for your top 50 prefixes (~12–18 mins).
  3) Temporarily disable the compaction job for the serving pool (we will revert after 6 hours).
- We're also preparing a short incident report and will propose a credit for customer impact (I can kick off approval).

Can we proceed with the rewarm and routing fallback now? If yes, we will start and I'll send you live updates.

Apologies again — we know this is disruptive and we'll make sure to follow up with a postmortem and preventative steps.

— Dylan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
